recommendations.title: Buy Cleveland Cavaliers -3.5
recommendations.reason: Recommendation: buy Cleveland Cavaliers -3.5 at home. The no-vig spread market gives them about a 52% chance to cover, and after our home-court and bucket adjustments we land near 56%. Priced at -118, that works out to roughly +3.9% expected value per dollar, so the side clears our minimum-edge filter.

recommendations.matchup: San Antonio Spurs at Minnesota Timberwolves
recommendations.reason: Recommendation: buy Minnesota Timberwolves on the moneyline at home. Stripping the book's vig puts their fair win probability around 36%, and after adjusting for our home-court signal and historical bucket performance we estimate 38%. At +170 that is roughly +2.7% expected value per dollar, which is the threshold this model requires before flagging a side.
